name: Prefect
description: Prefect is a workflow orchestration platform for Python. Turn any Python function into a flow with retries, caching and schedules, deploy it to a work pool and follow every run, its logs and task states in a web UI. It covers data pipelines, ML jobs and general automation.

notes.text: The UI asks for the full user:password auth string from /opt/prefect_data/.env. Clients need it as PREFECT_API_AUTH_STRING, plus PREFECT_API_URL=http://<IP>:4200/api.
Anyone with the auth string can deploy flows that run as root in this container. Install the packages your flows need with uv pip install --python /opt/prefect/.venv/bin/python.
